name: test_runner
description: Execute test suites and parse results. Supports pytest (Python), jest/vitest (JS/TS), and generic test commands.

manual.overview: Use test_runner to execute test suites and see results. Supports pytest for Python, jest/vitest for JavaScript, and any custom test command. Always run tests after making code changes.

examples.description: Run Python tests with verbose output

tips: Run tests after every code change to catch regressions early.
Use -v (verbose) to see individual test names and statuses.
Run specific test files instead of the full suite for faster feedback.
Set an appropriate timeout — test suites can vary from seconds to minutes.
edge_cases: Tests requiring database connections may fail without proper setup.
Some test frameworks need virtual environments or node_modules installed first.
Timeout should be set higher for integration/e2e tests.
